content:
The HWPX generation failed because the required risk rating string 'High (즉시조치)' was missing from the combined XML sections.
The test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present failed with an AssertionError during the call phase. Specifically, the verifier could not find the string 'High (즉시조치)' within the generated section0.xml and section1.xml files. While the environment setup and basic file generation worked (3 tests passed), the content mapping for '위험등급' (Risk Level) failed to correctly inject the severity map value into the HWPX XML structure.
